verses.1: The righteous, the longarmed,lotuseyed Rama, unable to see Sita wept with his senses overwhilmed by grief.
verses.2: Under the spell of Cupid, Rama uttered such words in grief which are otherwise unutterable. As if he was seeing Sita (before him) which was not a fact.
verses.3: O my beloved as you love flowers you are hiding your body behind the branches of the Ashoke tree that enhances my sorrow (paradoxically).
verses.4: O Devi I can see both your thighs which resemble banana trunk hidden behind a banana plant. It is not possible for you to hide them from me.
verses.5: O gentle one you are wandering in the karnikara garden, laughing and making fun. Enough of this , that causes my pain.
verses.6: O my dear Sita, why are you joking when I am exhausted? Such fun cannot be relished now.
verses.7: O darling joking specially in a hermitage is not appreciated. I know your nature.You love fun. O largeeyed Sita, come here. This cottage of yours is empty.
verses.8: O Lakshmana surely Sita is either devoured by demons or abducted. When I am weeping like this she is not coming to me.
verses.9: O Lakshmana, these herds of deer with their eyes filled with tears are as if telling me that she is eaten away by the demons.
verses.10: Alas, my noble lady, where have you gone? O chaste lady of excellent complexion, that queen Kaikeyi's desire will be fulfilled now.
verses.11: I left home with Sita. How can I reenter the inner apartment without her ?
verses.12: By Sita's abduction it will be clear to the world that I lack manliness and compassion. My cowardly nature will clearly manifest.
verses.13: After completing the period of my exile when Janaka , king of Mithila, enquires of her welfare how can I face him?
verses.14: If the king of Videha sees me without her, he will surely be distressed and will fall into a swoon for the love of his daughter.
verses.15: Or else, I will not go to the city ruled by Bharata. Without Sita even heaven will be empty for me.
verses.16: Go to the auspicious city of Ayodhya, leaving me here in the woods. I can never live without Sita.
verses.17: While embracing Bharata tightly, repeat my words, 'You are permitted by Rama to rule the earth.'
verses.18: My mother Kaikeyi, Sumitra and Kausalya should also be offered due obeisance. You should protect them with great effort, carrying out my instructions.
verses.19: My mother Kaikeyi, Sumitra and Kausalya should also be offered due obeisance. You should protect them with great effort, carrying out my instructions.
verses.20: O Lakshmana, subduer of the enemy this loss of Sita and me should be explained in detail to my mother.
